newsitem.title: USA: CRW CEO cuts stake to 28.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: CRW CEO cuts stake to 28.6 pct.

text.p: J. Brian O'Neill, chief executive of CRW Financial Inc, said on Tuesday he reduced his stake in the company to 28.6 percent.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, O'Neill said he sold 100,000 common shares of CRW on December 5, with 50,000 shares sold at $8.70 each and the remainder sold at $9.2505 each.
O'Neill said he held 2,196,193 common shares of CRW after the sale.
The King of Prussia, Pa.,-based company announced in October it would sell its receivable-management and debt-collection division and spin off its Casino Money Centers unit to shareholders.
After those transactions are completed, the company will hold only one asset -- 6.2 million shares it holds in TeleSpectrum Worldwide Inc.
